description: END-TO-END SMOKE TEST, NOT THE REGRESSION GUARD. Drives a Normal+Loop clip through a section-break park and checks the PRESENTED frame (what reached the GPU texture) advances, not just the MAPPED frame (what the engine wants to show) -- the distinction section_loop_normal.json cannot make. Uses the generated 150-frame test_media/basic_loop.mov (setup-test-media.ps1 locally, generated on CI runners per issue #86); with WaitUntil polling, loop wrap-back onto the frozen value cannot fake a pass: a frozen clip never leaves the [8±3] window and fails the timeout, a cycling clip leaves it and passes at the first out-of-window sample. IMPORTANT: this test PASSES against the pre-fix binary and therefore does not guard the section-break freeze. On a lightly-loaded box the decoder stays AHEAD of the mapped frame, so the exact-frame cache hit always lands and PlaybackPresenter's nearest-frame fallback -- the code the fix changes -- is never exercised. Reproducing the freeze needs the decoder to fall behind, which isn't something a script can force deterministically. The real guards are the unit tests DirectorRendererRoundtripTest.PausedContinuationClipUploadsNearestFrame (verified to fail without the fix) and PausedNonContinuationClipHoldsTextureOnMiss. This test earns its keep by exercising the whole path -- Director bake, bus serialization of inContinuation, presenter upload -- on real media.
